other_way.sql: SELECT DISTINCT a.customer_id FROM orders a JOIN orders b ON b.customer_id = a.customer_id WHERE CAST(a.order_ts AS DATE) = DATE '2025-05-12' AND CAST(b.order_ts AS DATE) = DATE '2025-05-17'
other_way.tradeoff: A self-join on customer_id finds the same customers, but it needs DISTINCT, where INTERSECT returns each customer once.
